mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_cart (name, image, user_id, service_item_id, service_package_id, requirement, amount, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{image}, #{userId}, #{serviceItemId}, #{servicePackageId}, #{requirement}, #{amount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, image, user_id, service_item_id, service_package_id, requirement, amount, create_time FROM service_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, image, user_id, service_item_id, service_package_id, requirement, amount, create_time FROM service_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
